messages:
ashok: noticed sustained queue growth on us-west1 GPU pool for ~8m, p95 queueing > 2s, pool util ~82%. lots of standard-tier workbacks showing up.
infra-bot: [ALERT] gpu_pool_us_west1.queue_depth=489 p95_wait=2.1s
ashok: tagging oncall. do we have a quick spill/fallback playbook?
maria: root cause looks like a network flap in us-west1-b that took out 3 nodes at 10:47. capacity dip ~14%. also a deployment with higher concurrency rolled yesterday.
kevin: immediate mitigation options: 1) admission control to protect premium 2) route standard to a smaller quantized model 3) spill standard to eu-west1 for participants who opted in.
sam: prefer fallback-first to avoid cross-region egress. warm a small pool of 7b-quant in region. fallback quality for many standard tasks is acceptable.
julia: warning: cross-region spill raises egress cost and latency. customers need to opt-in. also watch for synchronous timeouts for SDK clients.
ashok: rough policy I want to prototype:

```
policy_name: constrained_routing_v1
trigger: pool_util_pct >= 75
actions:
  - tier: premium -> local_preempt (reduce concurrency on standard)
  - tier: standard -> fallback_model=redwood-7b-q4 then spill_to=[eu-west1] if still queued
  - tier: free -> reject_with_429 retry_after=30
cooldown: 5m
```

kevin: add sampling for fallback responses so we can detect regressions. copy 1% of fallback requests to eval pipeline with original prompt and latency.
maria: also need billing tags: model_used and egress_region so customers see charges and console can show fallback events.
sam: infra note: keep a tiny warm pool of fallbacks per AZ to avoid cold-start tail latency. add prefetch on increasing queue slope.
julia: customer-facing defaults: enable fallback by default, disable cross-region spill unless customer checks opt-in. update consent schema.
kevin: operational safeguards: soft-preempt (reduce concurrency) before hard-preempt; circuit-breaker per-region and per-model to avoid ping-pong.
ashok: runbook draft for oncall:
- Detect CONSTRAINED by alert
- Toggle constrained mode (auto) -> routing changes apply
- If spill engages and eu-west1 grows, escalate to SRE lead
- Revert when pool_util < 60% for 10m

oncall: ack. two concerns: cost spikes from egress and customers surprised by fallbacks. recommend per-customer egress/spill budget and a console flag + notification.
maria: added budget and opt-in hook to the plan.
kevin: implementation plan: week1 constrained flag + local admission; week2 fallback routing + sampling; week3 cross-region spill opt-in + billing.
sam: infra will prepare warm fallback pools and add prefetch logic.
julia: I'll update the customer config schema and console text.
ashok: I'll write up RFC and assign owners. expected RFC id: 1766239810-tiered-spillback-rfc. posting tomorrow. :thumbsup:
